text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of Mejiro Dober's debut, and Mejiro Bright, Mejiro Ryan, and Air Groove have all come to show their support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wanting to meet the expectations of her loved ones, Mejiro Dober heads into her debut race burning with determination!
